newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent slides over stocks and Amuay refinery.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent slides over stocks and Amuay refinery.

text.p: SIMEX Brent December crude futures losses were extended in afternoon dealings on Tuesday following the late sell off in London.
December was last traded at $24.02 per barrel, down 16 cents from London and near the intraday low of $23.99. Volume was more than 741 lots.
January fell nine cents to $23.51 per barrel on 67 lots.
NYMEX crude futures, which fell one cent to $24.85 in New York, continued to slide on the after-hours ACCESS system to $24.75, but were modestly firmer than midday levels of $24.68.
Brokers said news overnight that New England lawmakers felt it was unlikely that the U.S. would face a heating oil supply crunch contributed to the weaker tone.
In addition, news that Venezuela's 108,000 barrels-per-day Amuay refinery would be back up mid November had also helped the downside.
